best_narrative.headline: Zocdoc: Telehealth Rivals Mobilize Federal Lobbying on Prescription Economics
best_narrative.body: Zocdoc operates as a healthcare directory and appointment platform with growing telehealth supply-side listings, creating indirect exposure to prescription economics and consumer protection enforcement that competitors are now actively lobbying to influence at the federal level. Four competing telehealth operators filed federal lobbying disclosures on telehealth-adjacent topics between May and July 2026, signaling industry-wide mobilization around reimbursement, advertising, and referral-fee structures. Industry-standard regulatory exposures for this business model include anti-kickback and fee-splitting laws, state medical advertising rules, and consumer protection regulations, particularly in top-state jurisdictions such as New York, California, and Texas. The recent Hims and Hers litigation and competitor federal advocacy activity suggest state attorneys general and federal regulators are intensifying scrutiny of referral economics and telehealth marketplace practices.
